title: Single-Cell and Integrative Analyses Uncover Therapeutic Potential of RFX1-Mediated Cuproptosis in PitNETs.
authors: Yang, Shuangjian; Pu, Changqin; Deng, Congcong; Bai, Xuexue; Wu, Si; Tian, Chenxin; Xu, Xueyou; Wang, Renzhi; Chang, Mengqi; Feng, Ming
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞和机器学习分析垂体神经内分泌肿瘤中铜死亡相关基因，鉴定RFX1为潜在治疗靶点，但核心是肿瘤分型与临床相关性，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pituitary neuroendocrine tumors (PitNETs) have different cell types and levels of growth. We do not fully understand why they grow so much. Cuproptosis is a new way that copper kills cells and it is important in cancer. But, we do not know how it works in PitNETs yet. METHODS: We used several methods like bulk and single-cell sequencing with machine learning to investigate cuproptosis in PitNETs. We used Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) and random forest to find important genes. Then, we did tests in the lab to see how these genes work. RESULTS: Analysis of cuproptosis-related genes (CRGs) revealed significant differences in expression and immune landscapes between invasive and non-invasive PitNETs. We established CRG-based molecular subtypes and a high-performance predictive model for tumor invasiveness. Notably, regulatory factor X1 (RFX1) was identified and validated as a key regulator that suppresses tumor growth and sensitizes cells to cuproptosis. These results highlight the clinical relevance of cuproptosis in PitNET progression and suggest RFX1 as a potential therapeutic target. CONCLUSION: This study establishes a single-cell-based molecular landscape of PitNETs and uncovers RFX1-mediated cuproptosis as a key suppressive mechanism of tumor progression. These findings not only deepen the understanding of PitNET heterogeneity but also propose RFX1 as a promising therapeutic target for PitNETs.
abstract_zh: 背景：垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（PitNETs）具有不同的细胞类型和生长水平。我们尚未完全理解其为何过度生长。铜死亡（cuproptosis）是一种铜诱导细胞死亡的新机制，在癌症中具有重要意义。然而，我们尚不清楚其在PitNETs中的作用机制。方法：我们采用多种方法，包括批量测序和单细胞测序结合机器学习，来研究PitNETs中的铜死亡。我们使用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和随机森林来识别关键基因。随后，我们在实验室中进行测试以观察这些基因的功能。结果：对铜死亡相关基因（CRGs）的分析揭示了侵袭性和非侵袭性PitNETs之间在表达和免疫景观上的显著差异。我们建立了基于CRG的分子亚型以及一个高性能的肿瘤侵袭性预测模型。值得注意的是，调控因子X1（RFX1）被识别并验证为抑制肿瘤生长并使细胞对铜死亡敏感的关键调控因子。这些结果强调了铜死亡在PitNET进展中的临床相关性，并提示RFX1可能是一个潜在的治疗靶点。结论：本研究建立了基于单细胞的PitNETs分子景观，并揭示了RFX1介导的铜死亡作为肿瘤进展的关键抑制机制。这些发现不仅加深了对PitNET异质性的理解，还提出RFX1作为PitNETs的一个有前景的治疗靶点。
